trustPage.title: Verification and trust
trustPage.lead: We only label what was actually checked, and we say clearly what we don't check.
trustPage.identity: The professional uploaded an identity document. A staff member compared the name and photo with the profile. The label shows the date of the check.
trustPage.qual: Each diploma, licence or certificate is checked individually. If the professional changes the details or the document, the label is removed until it is checked again.

kinds.NURSING_LICENSE: required for the Nursing care service

trustPage.notTitle: What we don't check or guarantee
trustPage.not1: Criminal record certificates are not checked in this first version.
trustPage.not2: Phone numbers are not verified by SMS.
trustPage.not3: Non-medical care is not medical treatment. For medical needs, consult a doctor.
trustPage.not4: Verification does not guarantee the quality or safety of a service.
trustPage.tip1: Call or meet the professional before confirming.
trustPage.tip2: Agree the terms in advance: hours, price and responsibilities.
trustPage.tip3: Don't send advance payments to people you don't know.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Short answers to the main questions.

items.a: In this first version the platform is free for families and professionals. You agree the price of the service directly with the professional.

items.q: Does sending a request mean the professional will definitely come?
items.a: No. The professional must accept, and then you confirm. The time is reserved only after confirmation.
A staff member compared an identity document with the profile details. It is not a safety guarantee.

items.q: When will I see the professional's phone number?
items.a: Contact details are revealed to both sides only after you confirm an accepted request.

items.q: How long do I have to confirm?
items.a: An accepted request must be confirmed within the time limit (usually 48 hours), otherwise it expires.
Yes. Choose Recurring, the days of the week and a period of up to 8 weeks.

items.q: How do I become a professional?
items.a: Sign up, complete your profile and submit it for review. It's published once approved.
Only customers with a completed request can leave a review, and every review is moderated.

aboutPage.title: About Carely
aboutPage.lead: A platform connecting families with independent care professionals in Armenia.
aboutPage.p1: Carely was created to make finding a care professional simple and transparent — for children, older people, patients and pets.
aboutPage.p2: Professionals work independently. The platform helps you find each other, agree on times and follow each request.
aboutPage.p3: We're honest about verification and label only what was actually checked.

legal.draftText: This text is a preliminary draft pending review by the operator and a lawyer. It has not been legally approved.

terms.p: Carely is an information platform connecting customers with independent professionals. The platform is not a party to the arrangement between them.
Users are responsible for the accuracy of their details and the security of their account.
Sending a request does not guarantee a service. An arrangement is confirmed after the professional accepts and the customer confirms.
Verification labels reflect only the specific check that was performed and are not a safety guarantee.
Reviews are published after moderation and must relate to a service that was actually provided.

privacy.p: Account details (name, email, phone), profile information, request details and verification documents.
To operate the platform, process requests, perform verification and provide support.
Contact details are visible only to participants of a confirmed request. Verification documents only to authorised staff.
Private documents are stored separately with no public access. Every view is logged.
You can ask for your data to be corrected or deleted by contacting support.
